notes: The supplied *is* of *how great is the darkness* goes to the predicate πόσον under rules 53 and 63, the subject being a lexical noun; rule 104 heads the degree correlative on the dimension word *great*.
s018 τό follows its noun and governs a verbless prepositional phrase, so it keeps only the relativizer and ἐν takes the copula (rule 31).
